name: What steps are involved in the remote closing coordination process?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in the remote closing coordination process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The remote closing coordination process typically begins once a property is under contract. It involves several key steps: initial communication with all parties (lenders, title, agents), document collection and review, timeline management for inspections and appraisals, scheduling the closing, and ensuring all final disclosures are provided. Your Kelby Contreras coordinator will proactively manage these steps, providing you with regular updates and guiding you through each stage, ensuring you know exactly what is needed from you and when. This structured approach helps prevent delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves initial communication, document collection, timeline management, and scheduling the closing, with your coordinator providing regular updates and guidance.
